purpose: Superset is read-only business analytics over curated projections. It has no Middleware V3 command authority: no command execution, no provider mutation, no operational writes and no secret-resolution authority. This contract records the audited boundary and pins it to the Middleware prep base.

v3_candidate_observed.authority: informational only; unmerged, owned by the Middleware V3 session

observed.identity: keycloak client superset-analytics; OpenBao workload superset-analytics; read-only database role
observed.public_exposure: supe.codestra.media through Caddy with native Keycloak OIDC only; loopback publish 127.0.0.1:8088 on the host

v3_expectations: Superset reads Middleware V3 outcomes only through curated reporting projections (replica or reporting schema), never through the Middleware API or the kernel database
No Superset alert, report or export may trigger a provider effect; the middleware-governed notification path stays the only delivery authority
Re-pin middleware.v3_final_sha after V3 merges; no other change expected
